vocab.example: If we send it today, we can get it signed this week.
vocab.example_vi: Nếu gửi hôm nay, chúng ta có thể hoàn tất việc ký trong tuần này.

vocab.example: Our director still has to sign off on the discount.
vocab.example_vi: Giám đốc của chúng tôi vẫn phải phê duyệt lần cuối mức chiết khấu.

vocab.example: The support clause on page four is not clear enough.
vocab.example_vi: Điều khoản hỗ trợ ở trang bốn chưa đủ rõ ràng.

vocab.example: Our legal team reviewed the contract yesterday afternoon.
vocab.example_vi: Bộ phận pháp chế của chúng tôi đã rà soát hợp đồng chiều hôm qua.

vocab.example: I am sending the final draft for your review today.
vocab.example_vi: Hôm nay tôi gửi bản dự thảo cuối cùng để anh chị xem lại.

vocab.example: Please tell me who the authorised person for this contract is.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng cho tôi biết ai là người có thẩm quyền ký hợp đồng này.

vocab.example: The contract value is printed on the first page.
vocab.example_vi: Giá trị hợp đồng được in ở trang đầu tiên.

vocab.example: We agreed a delivery schedule of three stages this year.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta đã thống nhất lịch bàn giao gồm ba giai đoạn trong năm nay.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: Good afternoon, Ms Hoa. I sent the final draft this morning.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Yes, I read it. Our legal team has two small comments.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: Please tell me. I would like to fix them today if possible.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: First, the support clause mentions office hours, but not weekends.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: I will add one clear line about weekend support in section three.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Second, the delivery schedule shows two stages, but we agreed three.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: You are right. That is my mistake, and I will correct it now.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Please also check the contract value on the first page.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: I checked it twice this morning, and the number is correct.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Good. Then my director can sign off tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Nam (Account Executive)
lines.text: May I ask who the authorised person for the signature is?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Our director, Mr Long. So we can get it signed before Friday.

questions.q: What is missing from the support clause?
options: The name of the legal team
The contract value is too high
The delivery schedule shows two stages instead of three
The final draft was sent late
